title: Passaggio a Wirex One? Tutto quello che devi sapere
notes: Official Wirex migration FAQ. It supports a regional Classic Wirex migration/closure of X-Accounts in the EEA, UK and Australia after 30 June 2026, with balances returned to the main balance. It does not support a global X-Accounts shutdown.

title: Renting Terms of Use
